_readme: Rules consciously judged to be registry MECHANICS rather than reporting
guardrails, and therefore allowed to live in an on-demand reference file
The test applied to every id below: does its absence change what the
workflow REPORTS or CONCLUDES, or does it merely block a mechanical step
in a way you cannot miss? A wrong form-field name yields an HTTP 403 or an
empty grid; a wrong PDF prefix yields a 404. That is self-announcing, so
the rule travels safely with the registry section you already had to open
Nothing that decides whether a title is clean, whether a parcel matches,
or whether a search was complete may ever be listed here. Three rules from
the first split were REFUSED this treatment and promoted back into the
core skill file instead: the two Norfolk 'EST. suffix' rules (they end in
'do not draw title conclusions from it alone') and the Plymouth
multi-property town-mismatch WARNING (it is a wrong-parcel guard).
Adding an id here is a decision, not a formality. Record why.
5c1b037faa31: Plymouth: navigate-direct option for the image viewer. Navigation mechanics; a wrong URL fails visibly.
c0611c7709e8: Plymouth: ctl numbers are unique only within a pager page. Selector mechanics.
7b9fc3db6c77: Plymouth: a row read from page 1 must be re-located after a pager walk. Selector mechanics; the script owns this path.
306ea7ed5fb3: Plymouth: when an unrecognised town abbreviation matters. The reporting consequence is the WARNING rule, which stays in core.
5cb99aa333aa: Plymouth: multi-result runs emit a WARNING and fire the address retry. Same — the WARNING itself is core.
5bb94809aa04: Suffolk: popups must be allowed for masslandrecords.com. The viewer visibly fails to load otherwise.
d8da9e868f83: Suffolk: some scanned text may not be legible. An observation about scan quality.
e2181ea5cff0: Suffolk: page 1 is always a recording cover sheet. Page-offset mechanics.
babae99a34c2: Middlesex South: Incapsula WAF returns 403 to headless browsers. Maximally self-announcing — the run fails outright.
56e5b08bb799: Middlesex South: separate last/first/middle fields, do not concatenate. A wrong shape returns an empty grid.
0c6d295b9627: Middlesex South: ACSResource.axd hi-res image trick. Image-fetch mechanics.
3cd9a741c51c: Norfolk: use the script fast path first, fall back on exit 2/1. Routing, and Step 1B in core already states it.
78439b5cc4bc: Norfolk: town code is WEYM, not WEYB. A wrong code yields no rows.
526fee342e54: Norfolk: PDF page prefix varies by batch, do not hardcode. A wrong prefix is a 404.
4698df219f8b: Norfolk: read actual href values off the image-list page. Same fetch mechanics.
d2d2c4cab83c: Norfolk: the script auto-fetches the abstract for selected/candidate/grantor rows. Describes script behaviour documented in core.
32d416c7db29: Norfolk: fetching the abstract by hand in a manual run. Manual-path mechanics.
ceaf5cec5445: Norfolk: the abstract also carries Doc$, page count, party lists, cross-refs. Descriptive; cross_references handling is core.
3c1dcd038750: Norfolk: save JPEG screenshots for auditability if needed. Output mechanics.
e5cbc97519e8: Norfolk: PDF.js fallback, use only if fetch-download fails. Fallback mechanics.
7d065c0f84ef: Norfolk: screenshot to confirm the render completed. Mechanics of a render that outlives the JS timeout.
a58ec310eedf: Barnstable: manual notes apply only on exit 2/1. Routing, stated in core.
afb7d262f30e: Barnstable: read actual href values before fetching. Fetch mechanics.
0747e7eccb9e: Barnstable: try Recorded Land first, then Land Court. Search ordering when the section is unknown; the stronger conditional rule (Registered Land known -> Land Court FIRST) stays in core.
93808e1e1ec8: Barnstable: PDF.js needs a blob worker, cross-origin workers are blocked. Viewer mechanics.
165461ad96e5: Barnstable: a CDN workerSrc silently never resolves. Viewer mechanics — and it only applies inside the PDF.js fallback this file describes.
dcfa8addda9a: Barnstable: never set workerSrc to empty, it blocks the JS event loop. Reads as a hard rule, but it is a rule about ONE line of the fallback snippet in this same file.
eb6a2fc0eb10: Barnstable: one render per tab, concurrent renders deadlock. Viewer mechanics.
